verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents headless operation through an official CLI that manages flags, segments, projects and environments from the terminal. It also offers an Admin API covering everything the dashboard does, and a Docker setup for running a full environment locally. These are strong building blocks for scripted automation, but the evidence never explicitly documents CI usage, so coverage of the story is partial. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline integration docs (e.g. GitHub Actions or other CI examples), documented non-interactive/token auth for the CLI in CI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Flagsmith CLI lets you manage flags, segments, features, projects and environments from your terminal, and evaluate flags the way an SDK would.
This is the API you use to programmatically manage your Flagsmith projects. Anything you can do in the Flagsmith dashboard, you can also do via the Admin API.
This guide explains how to run a full Flagsmith environment on your local machine using Docker.
